title: 第13章 嗜血术
content_zh:
“小娃儿，你往后命数还长，不知道道爷的心里担忧。”

    “道爷今年九十多，凭着炼血功这假仙之法吞吃血食，已经苟活数年，再往后还能活多久，道爷自己也不知道！”

    “我活了这一辈子，怎么也不会甘心活到头来一场空！”

    石屋内，李老道对韩榆说着内心想法，最后端起碗中精血，咕嘟一口饮下。

    白发苍苍，口唇间满是渗人的鲜红。

    这模样虽然吓人，韩榆倒是并不害怕，只是说：“道爷，你可要小心，万春谷不允许私下修炼其他功法，更不允许修炼这种跟魔门有关的功法。”

    “一旦被发现，怕是有性命之危。”

    李老道听他这么说，嘶哑笑道：“你这孩子心地是好的，像你奶奶一样。”

    “不过，我要是不练炼血功，说不定死得更快，还是练吧。”

    又对韩榆说道：“你为了等我，拒绝了那个韦师姐的好处，说起来也是我耽误了你，作为补偿，我就把我身上最后的一点本事都交给你吧。”

    “我的武功，对修行者来说不值一提，也没什么借鉴的必要，毕竟凡人打凡人的技击之法，说来说去也不过就是寻常。”

    “炼血功还有一个法术，名为嗜血术，可以通过嗜血的方式来短暂提升自己实力，只是要事先预备足够精血，或者事后紧急补充。这法术和血滴子一样，只能紧急时候用来保命，不到万不得已，千万不要用。一旦当着万春谷等修仙正宗门派用出，必然是要被人家追杀。”

    “现在我就把这嗜血术传授给你。”

    韩榆讶然：“道爷，你还藏了一个法术？”

    李老道嗤笑：“之前谁知道你是什么品性？我没把你翻脸拍死还传给你功法，就已经是看在你奶奶的面子上！”

    韩榆无言以对，他从记事开始就没有见过奶奶，倒是没想到因为奶奶被李老道这样另眼相看。

    学了嗜血术运用之法后，韩榆便回到自己石屋。

The eight god-transformation monks relied on the messenger to communicate, guessing and guessing, but there was no conclusion for a while.

In the end, it was the Demon Lotus Ancestor who spoke: "It is useless for us to think about this matter."

"Either find Qu Tanhua and ask about the fighting situation at that time."

"Either we join forces and go south together to investigate the situation in the southern region."

As soon as he said this, the Blood Spirit Ancestor asked the Wanxiang Ancestor: "Isn't there a strange star on Qu Tanhua? You should be able to see where he has gone through the stars!"

The ancestor of Wanxiang stared at the night sky and shook his head: "Either he is not on the stars at the moment, or he deliberately hid in a certain formation to prevent himself from appearing on the stars."

The Blood Spirit Ancestor and other god-transforming monks were stunned one after another.

Is Qu Tanhua hiding, or is he talking about being outside the stars?

"He took a teleportation magic weapon from Han Yu and moved it to the Northern Territory. It should have been moved this time, right?"

"Not necessarily. It is no accident that Xuan Luzi was seriously injured and his body was dead. If Qu Tanhua really found out that there was an enemy in the Southern Territory that was difficult to fight against, he would probably hide and never show up again." Dan Qingzi said, "After all, if there is nothing we can do about the Southern Territory, those of us will soon be liquidated by Han Yu and Qixing."

"Hiding is the safest thing."

After Dan Qingzi said this, everyone was silent again.

"Even if we don't count Qu Tanhua and the seriously injured Xuan Luzi, we still have seven god-transformation monks..." Demon Lotus Ancestor said solemnly, "Are we going to hide now? Or... wait a little longer?"

The ancestor of the Blood Spirit said: "If we can work together and go to the southern region to eradicate the weeds at this moment, regardless of whether the sect or the sect will follow the trend, it is actually not too late -"

"It's too late, it's already too late!" Ancestor Wanxiang sighed from the side.

"Don't you forget, what kind of plan did our ten god-transformation monks gather here for?"

"We thought from the beginning that Han Yu had a magic weapon to move. Even if we go to the Southern Territory together, Han Yu can come and go freely after moving, but we still can't eradicate the roots. So we can only set a trap to lure Han Yu to move to the Zhongtian Territory, and then catch him by surprise and let him enter the restriction that cannot be moved. Such a thorough attack."

"Then, how did our plan get ruined and now we have completely lost hope?"

"In the Southern Territory, after the Wangyou San people used all their strength to break through the disguise of our God Transformation Token, it was no longer possible for Han Yu to come to the Zhongtian Territory. After all, they could have thought that there were already God Transformation monks waiting for them in the Zhongtian Territory."

"In the small world of spirit beasts, Xuan Luzi was seriously injured and almost died. We all thought it was an accident. However, Han Yu and the others returned to the Southern Territory again. The bones died and Qu Tanhua escaped. This is no accident."

"Now, we seven god-transformation monks are going to the Southern Territory together. Han Yu, Wangyousan and Qixing can move to any place; we can't kill them, and it is impossible to eradicate them. Spreading our strength and two god-transformation monks guarding a sect will no longer be Han Yu's opponents, they will only be defeated one by one by them."

"It's too late to eradicate the roots! It's impossible to kill them!"

After Wanxiang Ancestor finished speaking, all the god-transformation monks became silent again.
